title: Reading an old map
bodyMd: An old town map shows the market square at twice the scale used for the surrounding streets. A researcher first suspects a drafting error, then notices that every guild stall is carefully labelled. She proposes that the map may have been designed to record market rights rather than to guide travel. She calls this an interpretation requiring comparison with the document’s original commission, not a proven fact.
